raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 12 (ingested 2026-01-17) delivered txn_ts as DD/MM/YYYY strings (e.g. '16/01/2026 06:00:11'), while the other batches use ISO format, so the plain CAST to TIMESTAMP fails. The fix parses the DD/MM/YYYY values explicitly and keeps the ISO cast for everything else; the day-first reading is supported by 16 being impossible as a month and by the batch covering that business date.","decision": "fix","confidence": 0.7,"pre_sql": [],"step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH t AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN txn_ts LIKE '__/__/____ %' THEN strptime(txn_ts, '%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S') ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM t;"}}
